original_ai_output.title_zh: 巴耶尔萨州专员称该州无埃博拉确诊病例
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚巴耶尔萨州政府表示，该州目前没有埃博拉病毒病确诊病例。卫生专员在耶纳戈阿的新闻发布会上称，在阿布贾于10月20日确认一例输入性埃博拉病例后，该州已加强疾病监测、应急协调和公共卫生宣传。他明确表示，截至发布会时，巴耶尔萨州未报告任何确诊病例。

key_facts.fact: 巴耶尔萨州政府称该州无埃博拉确诊病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Bayelsa State Government has said no case of Ebola Virus Disease has been confirmed in the state

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾于10月20日确认一例输入性埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: following the confirmation of an imported Ebola case in Abuja by the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention on October 20, 2026

key_facts.fact: 该州已加强疾病监测与应急协调
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the government had intensified disease surveillance, emergency coordination and public health awareness across the state’s eight local government areas
